name: CapitaLand Investment
business_summary: CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a Singapore-headquartered, asset-light real estate investment manager formed in 2021 via the restructuring of CapitaLand Limited, which spun off the development business (CapitaLand Development) and listed CLI as the fee-income-focused investment-management arm. CLI earns fund management fees, lodging management fees and investment income from stakes in the REITs and private funds it manages (CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust, CapitaLand Ascott Trust, CapitaLand China Trust, Ascendas REIT, and others), plus serviced-residence/lodging operations through The Ascott Limited. It targets S$200B in funds under management by 2028.
